A '''safety droid''' was in the service of [[At Attin's government]] in [[9 ABY]]. When Wendle tried to find the [[barrier]] access code to try and sneak a message out to find his son [[Wim]], the safety droid noticed a surge coming from the terminal.<ref name="SCEP5" />
